events.evidence: The Nasdaq Composite drops 654.94 points (-3.64%) on 24 July, marking its third-largest one-day point loss
The North American Aerospace Defense Command intercepts two Russian and two Chinese bomber aircraft flying together near Alaska
Two wildfires burning in Jasper National Park reach the Jasper townsite in Alberta

label.note: Sharp Nasdaq/S&P selloff plus Alaska bomber intercept; risk appetite hit broadly.
